import re
import sys


def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()

    # Count paragraphs
    paragraphs = []
    current_paragraph = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped_line = line.strip()
        if stripped_line:
            current_paragraph.append(line)
        else:
            if current_paragraph:
                paragraphs.append("\n".join(current_paragraph))
                current_paragraph = []
    if current_paragraph:
        paragraphs.append("\n".join(current_paragraph))
    paragraphs = [p for p in paragraphs if p.strip()]

    # Count sentences
    sentences = []
    sentence = []
    terminators = re.findall(r"[.!?]+", text)
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        char = text[i]
        if char.isspace():
            if sentence:
                if i == len(text) - 1 or text[i + 1].isspace():
                    if (
                        len(sentence) > 0
                        and (i < len(text) - 1 and text[i + 1].isspace())
                    ):
                        sentences.append("".join(sentence))
                        sentence = []
                    elif (
                        i < len(text) - 1
                        and text[i + 1].isspace()
                        and char in [".", "!", "?"]
                    ):
                        sentences.append("".join(sentence))
                        sentence = []
                else:
                    sentence.append(char)
            i += 1
            continue
        elif char in [".", "!", "?"]:
            sentence.append(char)
            if i < len(text) - 1 and text[i + 1].isspace():
                sentences.append("".join(sentence))
                sentence = []
            elif i == len(text) - 1:
                sentences.append("".join(sentence))
                sentence = []
            i += 1
        else:
            sentence.append(char)
            i += 1

    # Count words
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", text)

    # Find longest word
    longest_word = max(words, key=lambda x: len(x), default="-")

    print("paragraphs", len(paragraphs))
    print("sentences", len(sentences))
    print("words", len(words))
    print("longest", longest_word)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
